audit_type: fresh independent source-only audit of frozen expanded iteration 01 summary
scope: Original Mayfair 2010/2013 English 2–4-player base game, supplemented only by applicable previous-Mayfair unified base clarifications; excludes Up!, Underworld, Americana, Con Jobs, revised 2024 six-player edition and optional Gamble Variant.

baseline.authority: Complete original four-page Mayfair English rulebook; native title p1 states 2–4 players, native p4 copyright 2010/2013.

supplement.authority: Publisher previous-edition listing labels Mayfair Unified Rulebook updated July 2022; PDF copyright 2020. Native physical p2 Game Sets expressly instructs ignoring rules for absent expansions. Only positively applicable base clarifications used.

applicable_supplements: p6 public resources, marker exhaustion, unlimited bank, ownerless casino, unrestricted gambling dice
p9 immediate boss ties and priority; trading is not an action
p11 explicit whole-casino reorganization eligibility and sole-owner permission
p13 explicit boss-cash gamble cap and stake return
p15 multi-party trades and halted later trade steps
p16 setup F replacement and no actions/initiated trades at End of Game
excluded_material: Up! risers, raise action, same-height casino constraints, expanded player colors/count
Underworld deck/cards, acquire action, card effects, end-card scoring modifications
Americana, Con Jobs, revised 2024 six-player rules
source_silences: Neither supplied rulebook gives a procedure for equal highest initial two-dice rolls; no such procedure is asserted in the summary.
Neither provides a further winner tiebreak after equal points and equal money; summary accurately labels the silence.
The four-page original does not expressly cover two-player F setup replacement, marker exhaustion, or unlimited bank; these are explicit applicable unified clarifications, not unsupported inventions.

Ordinary action costs are stated as pay amounts without a separate explicit payment-recipient sentence in the original base procedures; the summary follows this wording. Gambling and income destinations are explicit and correctly preserved.

checked_claims.exact_summary_claim: This covers the **Mayfair 2–4-player base game**, including its two-player rules.
checked_claims.source_reference: Original p1 title, Summary, Objective; unified physical p2 Game Sets
checked_claims.assessment: Base player count, authors, point objective, base-only applicability and expansion/variant exclusions match. No expansion actions, risers, or card effects are imported.

checked_claims.exact_summary_claim: **9 usable casino tiles in each of 5 colors:** aqua, brown, gold, purple and silver.
checked_claims.source_reference: Original p1 Components; original p2 Setting Up; unified pp3–4 Components
checked_claims.assessment: Checked 9 usable + replacement tenth per color, player-color distinction, 12 dice, 10 markers, action card, chip, board, money, 49-card deck, 9 per color + 4 Strip including End of Game, player and House cards, million-dollar scale and public money.

checked_claims.exact_summary_claim: A **lot** is a board space without a casino tile.
checked_claims.source_reference: Original pp1–2 Components / Who Owns What; unified p6 Who Owns What; unified p10 Build
checked_claims.assessment: Marker ownership, die ownership/influence, tile replacing lot status, one or edge-connected same-color tiles on same block, immediate merger, no diagonal connection and no subdivision are correctly distinguished.

checked_claims.exact_summary_claim: The **boss** is the player owning the **highest individual die** in that casino
checked_claims.source_reference: Original pp1–2 Player Dice / Who Owns What; original p4 Reroll if Tied; unified p9 Settling Who’s the Boss
checked_claims.assessment: Individual maximum determines boss; same-player multiple highest dice are permitted; cross-player highest ties alone require rerolls. Neither die totals nor number of dice determine control.

checked_claims.exact_summary_claim: Divide the remaining shuffled deck into **4 roughly equal stacks**. Put End of Game **on top of the fourth stack**
checked_claims.source_reference: Original p2 Setting Up and Taking Turns; unified p5 Setting Up / Initial Properties; unified p16 2-Player Rules
checked_claims.assessment: All starting pieces and zero score, banker, removing End of Game, two accepted starting cards, lot markers, sum of card money values only in setup, visible discard piles, quarter-deck End insertion, highest of two dice choosing first player, and leftward turns match. Two-player F setup replacements are explicitly supported by unified p16.

checked_claims.exact_summary_claim: replace their die with your own **at the same current pip value**, not the board’s printed value.
checked_claims.source_reference: Original p2 Take Over Your Lot; unified p7 Step 2
checked_claims.assessment: Checked empty lot marker, opponent sprawled die replaced preserving current pips, empty tile receives printed value, own die unchanged, tile remains, resource exhaustion and immediate tie settlement before casino payment.

checked_claims.exact_summary_claim: every lot with a marker pays its owner **$1 from the bank**
checked_claims.source_reference: Original p2 Owned Lots Pay; unified p7 Step 3
checked_claims.assessment: All marked lots pay on each draw regardless of card or turn, including newly acquired lot; casinos are no longer lots and do not double-collect.

checked_claims.exact_summary_claim: A qualifying casino pays for **all its tiles**, not only the tile touching The Strip.
checked_claims.source_reference: Original p2 Casinos Pay / Pay Based on Color / Pay The Strip / Money Paid / Points Earned and diagram; unified p8 Steps 4–5
checked_claims.assessment: Color pays boardwide; Strip requires at least one adjacent edge and pays entire casino; money goes from bank to each die owner at $1/pip, and only boss scores one point per tile. Checked distinction between investor income and boss points.

checked_claims.exact_summary_claim: On your own turn you may **build, sprawl, remodel, reorganize and gamble** in **any order**
checked_claims.source_reference: Original p3 Ending Step 1 / Step 2 Play; unified p9 Steps 6–7
checked_claims.assessment: Draw/takeover, lot payment, casino money then scoring, discard, and Play sequence is correct. No off-turn actions. Repeatability, gamble once per turn, die reorganization limit, optional stopping, tie checks and trading being outside actions are supported.

checked_claims.exact_summary_claim: Choose **a lot you own**. Take back its marker, choose an **available** casino tile of any color, pay the **price printed on the lot**
checked_claims.source_reference: Original p3 Action – Build and Available Tiles; unified p10 Build
checked_claims.assessment: Ownership eligibility, printed cost, marker return, available tile, printed initial die value and immediate mergers/control changes match.

checked_claims.exact_summary_claim: Choose an **empty, unowned lot sharing an edge** with it, pay **twice that lot’s printed price**
checked_claims.source_reference: Original p3 Action – Sprawl; unified p10 Sprawl
checked_claims.assessment: Boss-only eligibility; same-color available tile; empty unowned edge neighbor; doubled printed cost; printed die value; property card staying in deck; takeover preserving current pips; own card leaving die unchanged are supported. Marked/built/diagonal destinations are excluded by these requirements.

checked_claims.exact_summary_claim: Choose a **new color with enough available tiles for the entire casino**. Pay **$5 per tile**
checked_claims.source_reference: Original p3 Action – Remodel; unified p11 Remodel
checked_claims.assessment: Boss-only, whole-casino replacement, enough new-color supply, $5 per base tile, old tiles returned, dice positions/values retained except required tie rerolls, mergers and possible boss loss all match.

checked_claims.exact_summary_claim: **Reroll all dice**, not a chosen subset. Each player rolls their own dice.
checked_claims.source_reference: Original pp3–4 Action – Reorganize and example; unified pp11–12 Reorganize
checked_claims.assessment: At least one own die, no boss requirement, sole-player casino permitted, pre-roll all-pip cost, every die rerolled by owner, each owner allocating only among their own original tiles, optional temporary markers, no die reorganized twice, merger-wide eligibility prohibition, and distinction from free tie rerolls match.

checked_claims.exact_summary_claim: **$5 per tile in that casino**, **your available money**, and **the boss’s available money**.
checked_claims.source_reference: Original p4 Action – Gamble; unified p13 Gamble
checked_claims.assessment: Checked opponent boss, House card, no opponent casino means unavailable, once per own turn, all three simultaneous limits, any two dice, no ownership-dice supply restriction, sum 3/4/9/10/11 equal-win, 2/12 double-win limited by boss cash, 5/6/7/8 loss, return/retention of own stake and correct money transfer destination. Optional bank layoff is excluded.

checked_claims.exact_summary_claim: score them **individually, from smallest to largest**, choosing the order of equal-size casinos.
checked_claims.source_reference: Original p2 Scoring and p3 scoring continuation/diagram; unified pp8–9 Score Casinos
checked_claims.assessment: Printed score track, individual casino award required to cross break, excess lost, no banking/combining, 8-to-10 and 8-to-12 examples, smallest-to-largest ordering and equal-size choice match.

checked_claims.topic: Immediate end, final payout and victory
checked_claims.exact_summary_claim: Make the **final payout for all owned lots and all casinos touching The Strip**, using normal money, boss-point and scoring-break rules.
checked_claims.source_reference: Original p4 Winning; unified p16 Winning
checked_claims.assessment: End of Game immediately blocks Play actions/initiated trades; final marked-lot + Strip payout, point winner then money tie-break, and immediate base-game 90+ victory match. No further tiebreak is invented. Underworld end-point modifications are correctly excluded.

checked_claims.exact_summary_claim: reroll **all dice currently tied for highest**, **for free**. Leave smaller dice untouched.
checked_claims.source_reference: Original p4 After Each Action: Reroll if Tied and diagram; unified p9 Settling Who’s the Boss
checked_claims.assessment: All current highest across players reroll; re-evaluate entire casino after each roll, including formerly lower unchanged dice; same-player highest or non-highest ties require none; no action/trade initiation interrupts; free rerolls independent of paid reorganization limit. Taking over/trading can trigger immediate resolution.

checked_claims.exact_summary_claim: if all 12 of yours are already on the board when you must place one in a casino
checked_claims.source_reference: Original p3 Available Tiles / Available Dice; unified p6 Your Resources
checked_claims.assessment: Checked nine usable tile limit and enough supply for whole remodel, compulsory own-die relocation on placement exhaustion, vacated tile unowned but scoring, casino with no dice ownerless, trade to free die, unrestricted gambling dice, compulsory marker relocation at ten with loss of old lot, unlimited bank and public money/piece/discard counts plus discard inspection.

checked_claims.exact_summary_claim: Trade any combination of **money, lots, dice in casinos and actions performed on the acting player’s current turn**.
checked_claims.source_reference: Original p4 At Any Time: Trading; unified p15 At Any Time: Trading; unified p9 tie-priority restriction; unified p16 end restriction
checked_claims.assessment: Any-time/off-turn and multi-player trades, appropriate marker/die replacements, preserving current die value, immediate boss effects, no trading points/tiles/future-turn promises, no off-turn actions, and halted subsequent steps when an element cannot happen match.

checked_claims.exact_summary_claim: Discard it in its appropriate pile, then **repeat Draw** until an A, B, C, D or E card has been drawn and resolved.
checked_claims.source_reference: Original p4 2-Player Rules; unified p16 2-Player Rules; original p4 / unified p16 Winning
checked_claims.assessment: F block cannot be built upon; setup F cards are discarded/replaced; normal-turn F cards place no marker but pay owned lots and indicated casino money/points, then discard and repeat property draw. Multiple consecutive F draws/payouts and no intervening actions are covered. Immediate End of Game overrides the repeat loop. No expansion card draws/effects are imported.

checked_claims.exact_summary_claim: play_time: "Not stated in the source rulebook"
checked_claims.source_reference: Both complete rulebooks; original p1 title and p4 copyright; publisher-downloads-visible.txt Previous Edition Rulebooks
checked_claims.assessment: No base-rulebook play duration is asserted; authors, edition, language, source identity and previous-Mayfair unified update are supported. Quick reference is consistent with detailed procedures. Verification remains unverified metadata rather than an unsupported claim of independent verification.

omissions.assessment: No material omission found after complete procedural comparison, including all draw branches, payouts, ownership/control, action costs and eligibility, scoring, trade constraints, exhaustion, two-player rules and end conditions. Flavor, credits, strategy passages and optional/expansion rules need not be summarized.
